youtube.baslik: With an implant, how many decibels separate the softest and loudest sound? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In a cochlear implant, the threshold (T) level is the lowest level at which the stimulus is barely detected, and the comfort (C or M) level is the upper level at which sound is loud but still comfortable; the electrical dynamic range between them is often only about 10 to 20 decibels. Compared with the natural ear's range of about 120 decibels, it is clear why the implant has to compress.
